source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Verify CX7 sensor names, descriptions and readings through local/in-band and OOB IPMI SDR and sensor lists.
procedure_facts: Run local `ipmitool sdr elist` and `sensor list`, plus LANplus OOB equivalents, filtering CX7.
criteria_facts: Sensor names, descriptions and readings match the specification in both list forms.
missing_source_information: Exact CX7 card/slot/sensor inventory, expected names/entities/units/readings/thresholds and availability states.
Meaning of source abbreviation IB as in-band IPMI, BMC endpoint/credentials and ipmitool version.

original_test_intent.statement: Compare CX7-related sensor inventory and readings from host-local in-band IPMI and remote BMC LANplus paths against the approved sensor specification.
must_preserve: Both `sdr elist` and `sensor list` through local and OOB paths.
Names, descriptions and readings, not NIC driver/firmware inventory.
must_not_infer: IB as InfiniBand fabric telemetry; here it denotes in-band/local IPMI context.
Filtered output as proof no expected sensor is missing.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly rejects DeepSeek's unrelated ethtool/mlxfwmanager output and requires secure local/OOB ipmitool evidence plus field-level CX7 spec comparison.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly disambiguate in-band from InfiniBand, require unfiltered inventories to detect absent/misnamed sensors, or correlate duplicate CX7 cards to SDR entity IDs/slots.

related_records: NIC firmware inventory does not satisfy BMC sensor visibility.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Safe local actuals can be collected before expected values; OOB collection awaits credential handoff but capability remains fully automatable.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Collect complete local and OOB sensor inventories, then filter/correlate every CX7 sensor by slot/entity and compare field by field. Missing spec or credentials delays comparison/OOB collection, not automation capability.

conditions_present: Commands and both access paths are read-only and well defined.
missing: CX7 slot/entity sensor spec, BMC endpoint/managed credential, expected states/units/ranges and ipmitool semantics.
provider: Lab/security owner supplies managed BMC access.
safe_read_only_work: Collect local full SDR/sensor output, BMC/FRU/PCI slot inventory and ipmitool version; collect OOB only after secure credential handoff.
prohibited_until_resolved: Inline password, log clearing, sensor threshold/rearm changes or PASS without spec.
closure_evidence: Complete local/OOB outputs with timestamps and BMC identity; slot/entity correlation; field-level spec comparison.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify CX7 Sensors through In-Band and OOB IPMI
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every expected ConnectX-7 sensor's name, SDR description/entity, state, units and reading through both host-local in-band IPMI and remote BMC LANplus paths against the approved platform sensor specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact server/BMC firmware, CX7 cards/slots/FRU identity, IPMI SDR repository and ipmitool version. 'In-band' means local system-interface IPMI, not InfiniBand link telemetry.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All expected CX7 sensors for every installed card through four evidence views: local SDR extended list, local sensor list, OOB SDR extended list and OOB sensor list. No threshold or BMC state changes.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Server/BMC identity; CX7 slot/serial/FRU/entity map; expected sensor names/numbers/descriptions/entity IDs/units/readings/states/thresholds/tolerances; ipmitool version; BMC endpoint and managed credential; timestamp tolerance between paths.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture unfiltered local `sdr elist` and `sensor list`, then CX7-filtered views with exit status. Through a managed secret channel capture identical unfiltered and filtered LANplus outputs from the same BMC. Correlate each expected sensor to card/slot/entity and compare path-to-path and to spec; retain missing/duplicate/unavailable entries rather than hiding them with grep.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC and card population; local IPMI device available; BMC reachable; clocks aligned; no sensor/SDR update; credentials protected.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Host/BMC firmware/ipmitool/CX7 slot/FRU identity; exact commands/timestamps; full and CX7-filtered local/OOB SDR/sensor outputs; exit codes; field-level matrix of sensor number/name/description/entity/state/units/reading/thresholds; missing/duplicate/path mismatch analysis; logs and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed platform/BMC CX7 sensor specification. Pass requires every expected sensor in both paths with matching identity/semantics and reading/state within the stated tolerance, no unexplained extras/missing/NA values and no collection error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not put passwords on command line/logs, use insecure cipher overrides, clear SEL/SDR, change thresholds, rearm sensors, treat grep-only output as completeness, confuse InfiniBand telemetry with in-band IPMI or substitute firmware inventory.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No approval for local read-only collection; BMC credential owner authorizes OOB access; platform engineer approves spec/tolerance and disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can collect both paths and compare fields after credential handoff; engineer judges permitted deviations.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: None for read-only collection; on BMC/session instability stop, preserve output and avoid retries that could lock accounts.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong host/BMC, sensor repository changing, credential unavailable/locked, local/OOB timestamps not comparable, incomplete unfiltered output, unresolved slot/entity mapping or contradictory specification.

identified_defects: DeepSeek collects NIC firmware rather than sensors.
In-band abbreviation can be confused with InfiniBand.
Grep-only output hides missing or duplicate sensors.
reason_for_change: Preserve the exact IPMI sensor test and make completeness, multi-card correlation and secret-safe dual-path comparison explicit.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Networking-00042-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Local/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` CX7 checks and field-level criteria.

removed_ambiguities: Defines IB as in-band IPMI, not InfiniBand.
resolved_blockers: Safe local actuals are collectible now; OOB/spec inputs are provider-closable.
remaining_blockers: PASS awaits sensor spec and secure OOB handoff.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents an empty `grep CX7` result from looking successful by retaining full inventories and requiring every sensor to map to a specific CX7 slot/entity across local and LANplus paths.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Read-only dual-path sensor scope is explicit; no DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 59 requires CX7 SDR and sensor lists through local/in-band and OOB LANplus.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 rejects firmware substitution; V3 adds in-band disambiguation, full inventory and multi-card entity correlation.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Local actuals are safe; OOB requires managed credentials; no state change or PASS without spec.
